    return Color3.fromRGB(math.floor(c.R*255*factor), math.floor(c.G*255*factor), math.floor(c.B*255*factor))
end

    local cs = currentThemeGradient
    if isSuper then
        local kps = {}
        for _, kp in ipairs(cs.Keypoints) do

        end
        numGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(kps)
    else
        numGradient.Color = cs
    end
end

    local relX = input.Position.X - sliderTrack.AbsolutePosition.X

local function formatNumber(exp)
    if exp >= 1.79e308 then return "∞", 0 end
    if exp < 3 then return string.format("%.2f", 10^exp), 0 end

    local mantissa = 10 ^ (exp % 3)
    local idx = math.floor(exp / 3)
    local suffix = getSuffix(idx)

    local text = string.format("%.2f", mantissa) .. (suffix ~= "" and " " .. suffix or "")
    -- Trim the string display if it exceeds the max length
    if maxStringLength > 0 and #text > maxStringLength then
        text = string.sub(text, 1, maxStringLength) .. "..."
    end

    return text, idx
end

            exponent = 2
            isResetting = false
        end
    elseif not isPaused then
        if isMultiply then

        else
            exponent = exponent * (1 + (currentVal - 1) * dt * 2)
        end
    end
    
    local text, idx = formatNumber(exponent)
    numLabel.Text = text

end)

local function compressLZW_Base92(str)
    local dict = {}
    for i = 0, 255 do dict[string.char(i)] = i end
    local dictSize = 256
    local w = ""
    local res = {}

    local function emit(code)
        local c1 = math.floor(code / 92) + 1

                dictSize = 256

            w = c
        end
    end
    if w ~= "" then
